title: Assign exact roles and initial private Ghost Channel knowledge
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_PILOT.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md and the frozen sources under docs/design/ first. acceptance: Every supported table size receives the exact canonical counts with exactly one The Null and one role per unique member.
Initial knowledge fixtures prove that an operative sees operative allies, while no other role or operative identifies The Null.
Repeated seeded setup is deterministic, leaves inputs unchanged and rejects impossible roster sizes/duplicate identities atomically.
